barcelona-montserrat-and-priorat-long-sw.title: Barcelona · Montserrat and Priorat Long Sweep
barcelona-montserrat-and-priorat-long-sw.slogan: A 346 km loop out of Montserrat mountain road
barcelona-montserrat-and-priorat-long-sw.story: Sawtooth mountains, wine roads and a grown-up Catalan riding day. Out of Collbató and back again: 346 km, roughly 6 h 39 in the saddle. It goes by way of Cardona castle sight, Siurana cliff village and in Falset. Montserrat mountain road is the high point. It is a high-mountain day.

scenicChapters.title: German Fairy Tale Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 17 km this is German Fairy Tale Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
